title: Use the requested target and actual identity
when: Before execution or evidence acceptance, when candidate/environment/phase can differ from existing proof.
need: Select phase by the obligation, not the URL name. Read the bound candidate/environment; Stage proof cannot stand in for Production and an earlier candidate cannot prove a later one.
surface: Intake attachment; bound target refusals; standalone environment obligations
gap: Review question: should evidence summaries lead with what was checked, where and against which candidate, before implementation identifiers?
